description_en: Queries the details of stack group operations in an Alibaba Cloud region
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询资源栈组操作列表详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-stack-group-operations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-group-name MyStackGroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStackGroupOperations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the stack group. The name must be unique within a region. The name can be up to 255 characters in length, and must start with a digit or a letter. It can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组名称。名称在单个地域内唯一。  
长度不超过255个字符，必须以数字或英文字母开头，可以包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: stack_group_name

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for the number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。  
取值范围：1~50。  
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for the page number in a paged query. Starting value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的页码。  
起始值：1。  
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: The paging Settings for the page number in a paged query
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码

PageSize.description_en: The paging Settings for the number of entries returned per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

StackGroupOperations.description_en: The list of stack group operations
StackGroupOperations.description_zh: 资源栈组操作详情列表

Action.description_en:
The action of the operation. Valid values:

CREATE: creation

UPDATE: update

DELETE: deletion

DETECT_DRIFT: drift detection
Action.description_zh:
操作动作。

取值：   

CREATE：创建。

UPDATE：更新。

DELETE：删除。

DETECT_DRIFT：偏差检测

CreateTime.description_en: The start time of the operation. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 操作开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the operation. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format
EndTime.description_zh: 操作结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

StackGroupId.description_en: The ID of the stack group

StackGroupName.description_en: The name of the stack group

Status.description_en:
The status of the operation. Valid values:

RUNNING: The operation is running.

SUCCEEDED: The operation succeeded.

FAILED: The operation failed.

STOPPING: The operation is being stopped.

STOPPED: The operation is stopped
Status.description_zh:
操作状态。

取值：  

RUNNING：运行中。

SUCCEEDED：成功。  

FAILED：失败。

STOPPING：停止中。 

STOPPED：已停止

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of stack group operations
